SignIn.title: Welcome!
SignIn.body: Log in or create your account and let's get started

VerifyEmail.title: Check your email
VerifyEmail.body: A sign in link has been sent to your email address

Home.title: This is a website for showing off your portfolio. Log in and tell us about the projects you have built! We'll display it in a nice and concise way on our page. It's something between Github's profile and LinkedIn's projects section.

ManageContent.title: Manage page content
ManageContent.pageNameLabel2: Your page URL will look like this: portie.me/p/page-name
ManageContent.pageNamePlaceholder: short word to append to the URL
ManageContent.wrongLinkError: This link is incorrect. Paste full link from the browser.
ManageContent.labelMaxCharsError: The label can have a maximum of 15 characters
ManageContent.projectTopLinkLabel2: The top part of your project's card, with logo, project name and project description, is a link and can be clicked on. This usually is a link to the landing page of your project.
ManageContent.projectBottomLinkLabel2: The bottom part of your project's card, with skills chart, is a link and can be clicked on. This usually is a link to the technical artifacts related to the project like Github repository with code or Figma designs.
ManageContent.projectSkillNameIsTooLongError: Skill name can have a maximum of 32 characters
ManageContent.projectSkillValueMustBeIntegerError: Skill value must be an integer between 1 and 100
ManageContent.projectSkillValueLabel2: Between 1-100, where 100 indicates the bar in a chart filling 100% of the available project's card width.
ManageContent.displayOrderMustBeIntegerError: Display order value must be an integer greater than 0
ManageContent.displayOrderLabel2: Determines ordering of this project on your page compared to other projects. Values closer to 1 are displayed more towards the top.
ManageContent.pageDoesNotExistText: Page you want to edit does not exist
ManageContent.pictureFileIsTooBig: Maximum size of picture is 2 MB
ManageContent.invalidPictureFileTypeError: This picture type is not supported
ManageContent.projectRemovedInfo: Project removed. For changes to persist click the save button.
ManageContent.skillRemovedInfo: Skill removed. For changes to persist click the save button.
